richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Coimbatore

c: Coimbatore is the big industrial city of western Tamil Nadu, known for its textile mills, pump and motor makers and its many engineering colleges. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Coimbatore to colleges, schools, factory campuses, gated communities, municipal parks and hospitals. Our Fun Fitness machines are built at our factory in Vasai, about 1,030 km away, and sent by road.

The city's climate is milder than most of Tamil Nadu. It sits close to the Western Ghats, and the breeze through the Palakkad Gap keeps many days pleasant. People here can use an open gym through most of the year and at most times of day, so a well-planned gym gets steady use. Gated communities on the city's edges often want a gym that matches their club house, while college and factory campuses want machines that a large group can share.

items.q: How much space does an 8 Station Multi Gym need?
items.a: It needs the frame area plus clear space on all sides for users to step on and off. Send us the site plan and we will mark the exact zone on the layout drawing.

items.q: Can a gated community in Coimbatore choose colours for the machines?
items.a: Yes. We have more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and can suggest a scheme that suits your club house and garden.

items.q: Do you deliver and install in Coimbatore?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at Vasai, send the machines by road and install them with our own team or a dealer covering south India.
